item.summary: fix(cron): mutex blank --model/--thinking with matching clear flags (#119894) * fix(cron): reject blank --model/--thinking on cron edit Empty Commander values skipped the clear-* mutex after normalize, so --model '' --clear-model still cleared the override. Align with fallbacks and delivery clear presence checks. Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger * test(cron): align empty model/thinking edit expectation with blank reject The legacy cron-cli suite still expected blank --model/--thinking to be omitted; that contradicts the fail-closed blank validation and broke CI. Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger * fix(cron): mutex blank --model/--thinking with matching clear flags Standalone blank overrides stay omitted. Flag presence now conflicts with --clear-model/--clear-thinking instead of silently applying the clear. Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger * test(cron): focus blank clear mutex coverage Amp-Thread-ID: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a0220d-eaa0-76b4-adb9-68841f015b75 --------- Co-authored-by: zyw02 Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger Co-authored-by: Amp <amp@ampcode.co
